The '''Imperial Corps of Bioengineers''' was a scientific department of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] that specialized in retrieving, studying, and [[Bioengineering/Legends|bioengineering]] various specimens of plants and animals throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. [[Dusque Mistflier]], [[Willel]], and [[Tendau Nandon]] were all members of the Corps. It is unknown if this unit had any relation to the [[Imperial Biological Weapons Division]].
